workarounds.symptom: bug: sign-in error page crashes on messages containing a percent sign
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(web): preserve decoded authentication error messages. Target files: web/src/features/auth/AuthErrorPage.clienttest.tsx, web/src/features/auth/AuthErrorPage.tsx, web/src/features/auth/SignInPage.tsx. When sign-in fails, the error page is often the only place a user can see what the identity provider reported. Next.js URL-decodes query parameters before placing them in `router.query`, but Langfuse's sign-in and authentication-error pages decoded those strings again. A message such as `100% complete` therefore became a r... (Ref: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/17835)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Azure AI Foundry Anthropic endpoints 400 when azure_ad_token leaks into request body
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(azure_ai): keep azure_ad_token out of the request body. Target files: litellm/images/main.py, litellm/utils.py, tests/unit/llms/azure_ai/test_azure_ai_entra_auth.py. Calling an Azure AI Foundry model through `azure_ai/` with an Entra token (`azure_ad_token`) and no API key failed with a 400, because litellm sent the token in the JSON body as well as the `Authorization: Bearer` header. Foundry rejects unknown body params, so GPT, Claude and Cohere embedding deployments all answered 400 (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49769)

workarounds.symptom: AdaMSS example scripts broken on transformers 5.x
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix broken examples on transformers 5.x (target_modules, dataset IDs, warmup_ratio). Target files: examples/adamss_finetuning/glue_adamss_asa_example.py, examples/adamss_finetuning/glue_adamss_asa_manual_example.py, examples/adamss_finetuning/image_classification_adamss_asa.py.
